# Whitepaper or report — template

Length: 2,500–5,000 words, 8–15 designed pages. Job: show expert insight or original data and capture B2B leads.
Design: Canva brand template from the client brain. Output: PDF plus an ungated landing page summary.

---

## Cover
- Title: {Clear promise or finding, for example "The 2027 state of {topic} in {market}"}
- Subtitle: {Who it is for and what they get}
- Client logo. Date: {month year}. Version: {v1.0}.

## Page 2 — Executive summary (300 words max)
- The problem in 2 sentences.
- 3–5 key findings, each with 1 number.
- What the reader should do next, in 1 sentence.

## Section 1 — The problem today
> Show the cost of the problem with sourced data. Use 1 chart.

## Section 2 — What we found / our approach
> For a data report: method (sample size, dates, market), then findings with charts.
> For an insight paper: the framework in 3–5 steps or parts, with a diagram.
> State the method honestly. Do not present an estimate as measured data.

## Section 3 — What good looks like
> 2–3 examples. Use real customer stories only with a signed release. Otherwise use "a {industry} company in {market}" with permission.

## Section 4 — How to start: a checklist or maturity model
> A page the reader can print and use. This page gets shared most.

## Section 5 — About {client}
> 100 words. 1 CTA: {demo | contact}.

## Method and sources
> Full list of sources and the method notes.

---

## Gating
- Form fields: name, work email, company, role, country. Do not ask for more than 5 fields.
- Country field drives the consent text from `market-rules.json` (`form_consent`).
- After download: the email service (Service 1) starts the nurture flow for this asset.

## Repurpose pack (the repurposer agent makes these)
- Landing page summary (500 words, ungated, with the key findings — this page wins search and AI citations).
- 3 nurture emails, 5 LinkedIn posts, 2 short video scripts, 1 sales one-pager, 1 webinar outline.
